scope: Read-only technical reconstruction; stored elapsed durations only; no statistical intervals, sampler calls or new timing

scopes.additional_verification: Completed coordinator calls returning newly_executed=false; kept outside primary execution cost
scopes.all_invocations: All coordinator calls, including additional verification; operational consumption, not standardized time-to-inference
scopes.ordinary_workflow: Sum ordinary subprocess creation-through-exit wall over every registered actual attempt; includes ordinary output/diagnostics, excludes outer audit and inter-call waiting
scopes.research_execution: Sum all coordinator run/retry calls except completed verification-only returns; includes recorded refusals/recovery/audit/sealing; excludes ledger writes, report observations and inter-call waiting
